summary: PLAT-103 shipped in one PR (#1): validateApp now throws if owner is missing/blank (shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0, breaking). Billing passes owner 'payments', reports 'insights' (from package.json team). Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in-repo and is inlined at build, so no registry release/dependency bump was needed and one PR was safe; core-shell also calls validateApp, so I passed owner 'platform' (its package.json team) to avoid breaking it. Local builds of billing and reports passed; CI and CD green.
